verify: if [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn -B verify; else ./gradlew build; fi
format: if [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn -B spotless:check || true; else ./gradlew spotlessCheck || true; fi

idioms: Detect Maven vs Gradle from pom.xml / build.gradle and use ONLY the client's build tool.
Match the client's Java version from pom.xml <maven.compiler.release> or build.gradle toolchain.
Spring Boot projects: use constructor injection and the client's existing configuration style (properties vs YAML).
Tests match the client's framework (JUnit 4 vs 5, Mockito vs other) — detect from existing test dependencies.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: imperative summary referencing their issue tracker key (e.g. JIRA PROJ-123).
never: Never upgrade dependency versions unless that IS the task.
Never mix Gradle Kotlin DSL and Groovy DSL in one change.
